Physically convincing high quality 3D rendered appearance with natural detailed materials, matching realistic artisan copper ring inventory art. Soft upper-left key light, clear highlights and readable silhouette at 48 pixels. No frame, text, symbols, watermark, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, hands or extra objects. Subject: Grave Thread. Black binding drawn from the Wilderness dead. A compact skein of black fibrous thread tied at the waist, looped strands with soft silver-gray edge light. Clearly fine textile thread, no spool, no bones.
